tasks.spec:
You are building an OFFLINE evidence-freezing harness in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL=https://w.example`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: scripts/ringer/environment_narration/baseline.py (new) and tests/test_environment_baseline.py (new). Never edit storygame/, data/, docs/, bench/frozen/, .plans/, or any file under scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/ (import from it, do not change it). Never make a network call.

WHY: the engine consumes a boarding-only command and answers with engine-written text (item notice_text joined into one sentence) instead of narrator prose; the narrator prompt it would otherwise get lists only the protagonist in THINGS, so the laptop on the passenger seat appears only in a background 'Just before this:' line. We need frozen, reproducible evidence of exactly what the current code does, per case, before anything changes. READ FIRST: scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/boarding_probe.py (finished harness: reuse its state setup, Jev stub, item-facts stub and the way _control_prompt calls WorldCapture.before_turn then CloudflareTurnProvider.__call__ to capture the narrator request bypassing the engine-text shortcut; import by path with importlib/sys.path the same way scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/open_probe.py imports live_baseline), storygame/runtime/item_facts.py (ItemFactsProvider.__call__ and _player_lines: the engine-text shortcut when command_consumed and prior_steps, sets last_turn_engine_text), storygame/runtime/seating.py (board_vehicle, SeatingResult), storygame/runtime/capture.py (WorldCapture.before_turn), worker/src/index.js (default model constant).

BUILD scripts/ringer/environment_narration/baseline.py with CLI `python scripts/ringer/environment_narration/baseline.py --out PATH` writing one JSON file (indent 2, sorted case order as listed, deterministic: running it twice on a clean tree yields byte-identical output; no timestamps). Package: data/stories/continuity-initiative. Top-level keys: schema (1), source, historical_artifacts, cases.
- source: git_sha (git rev-parse HEAD), dirty (bool: tracked-file changes under storygame data worker scripts tests), package_hash (sha256 over sorted relative paths + file bytes of the package dir), worker_default_model (parse the default model string out of worker/src/index.js; fail loudly if not found), model_override_env (value of CF_AI_MODEL or null), deployed_model_verified (always false), network_calls (always 0).
- historical_artifacts: for each of bench/results/boarding-probe-live/probe.json, bench/results/open-probe-live/probe.json, .plans/1a-transcript-continuity/baseline-live-narrations.json, .plans/1a-transcript-continuity/boarding-probe-prereg.md: {path, exists, sha256 or null}; plus one entry for the git object 5ea0119955c62b84699a8dc7878a4af770b55a7e:.plans/world-model.md checked with `git cat-file -e` (exists true/false, no content). A missing artifact is RECORDED, never fabricated or skipped.
- cases: exactly these ids in this order, each declaring its simulated classifier answers (these stand in for the Jev boarding classifier and are recorded as inputs, not measurements): boarding_go_to_truck (place outside_house, 'Go to the truck.', boards true, only_boards true); boarding_get_in (outside_house, 'Get in.', true, true); boarding_enter_truck (outside_house, 'Enter the truck.', true, true); boarding_from_kitchen (kitchen, 'Go out to the truck.', true, true); already_seated (start with the protagonist already seated in the truck by running one real 'Enter the truck.' before_turn under the stubs, then 'Get in the truck.', true, true); compound_enter_and_inspect (outside_house, 'Enter the truck and inspect my laptop.', boards true, only_boards false); approach_truck (outside_house, 'Approach the truck.', boards false, only_boards false); look_around_outside (outside_house, 'Look around.', boards false, only_boards false). Discover the real place ids and thing names from the package; the laptop is 'Kristin's laptop', its seat 'passenger seat', the protagonist 'Kristin'.
  Per case record: id, place, command, classifier_answers {boards, only_boards}; state_hash_before and state_hash_after_implicit (sha256 of canonical sorted-key JSON of the runtime facts before the turn and after WorldCapture.before_turn's implicit moves); implicit_steps (list of strings); command_consumed (bool); engine_text_turn (bool: the product path ItemFactsProvider.__call__ answered with engine text, read from last_turn_engine_text after running the real __call__ with the dispatch stubbed to raise if it is ever called on an engine-text turn); engine_text (the displayed narration string of that turn, else null); narrator_request {system, user, source} where source is 'product' when the product path really sent it, or 'bypass_for_capture' when you captured it by calling the base CloudflareTurnProvider.__call__ as boarding_probe does for consumed turns; things_names (names listed in the THINGS section of the user text, parsed by section heading, not regex over prose); just_before_line (the text after 'Just before this:' or null); expected_observations (a list of {thing, place, must_be_described, source}; source is the string 'plan regression matrix'; boarding_*, already_seated and compound_enter_and_inspect expect Kristin's laptop at the passenger seat with must_be_described true; approach_truck and look_around_outside expect an empty list); omissions (expected_observations whose thing is absent from things_names, as thing names); laptop_only_in_background_line (bool: laptop named in just_before_line and absent from things_names).
- Do not score narration quality and do not call any model. This file is evidence for T2-T5.

TESTS FIRST in tests/test_environment_baseline.py (hermetic; monkeypatch socket.socket and urllib to raise so any network use fails the test): output is byte-identical across two runs; top-level schema and case id order; boarding_go_to_truck, boarding_get_in, boarding_enter_truck, boarding_from_kitchen have engine_text_turn true, command_consumed true, things_names exactly ['Kristin'], laptop_only_in_background_line true and omissions ['Kristin's laptop']; approach_truck and look_around_outside have engine_text_turn false and no omissions; compound_enter_and_inspect is not consumed; already_seated records its own engine_text_turn value without asserting a specific sentence beyond containing 'already'; a missing historical artifact (monkeypatch the path list to a nonexistent file) is recorded with exists false; the worker default model parse fails loudly on a source file without it. Run the tests, see them fail, then build. If a case cannot reproduce what this spec states, do NOT bend the code or the test to fit: record the real observed values in the output and say so in your final message. FINISH: ruff format and ruff check both files.
tasks.check: cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL=https://w.example && set -o pipefail && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov tests/test_environment_baseline.py 2>&1 | tail -15 && .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/environment_narration/baseline.py --out /tmp/env-t1-a.json && .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/environment_narration/baseline.py --out /tmp/env-t1-b.json && cmp /tmp/env-t1-a.json /tmp/env-t1-b.json && .venv/bin/python -c "import json;d=json.load(open('/tmp/env-t1-a.json'));ids=[c['id'] for c in d['cases']];assert ids==['boarding_go_to_truck','boarding_get_in','boarding_enter_truck','boarding_from_kitchen','already_seated','compound_enter_and_inspect','approach_truck','look_around_outside'],ids;assert d['source']['network_calls']==0 and d['source']['deployed_model_verified'] is False;b=[c for c in d['cases'] if c['id'].startswith('boarding_')];assert all(c['engine_text_turn'] and c['command_consumed'] and c['laptop_only_in_background_line'] for c in b),[ (c['id'],c['engine_text_turn'],c['laptop_only_in_background_line']) for c in b];print('ok',len(ids))" && git diff --quiet -- storygame data docs worker bench/frozen scripts/ringer/transcript_1a && .venv/bin/python -m ruff check scripts/ringer/environment_narration/baseline.py tests/test_environment_baseline.py && .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check scripts/ringer/environment_narration/baseline.py tests/test_environment_baseline.py
